recentItems.title: Israeli Forces Raid Nablus and Kidnap Palestinians
recentItems.description: On Monday night, the Israeli army launched a large-scale raid on Nablus in the occupied West Bank. Israeli soldiers invaded the city from several directions and kidnapped Palestinians from multiple areas, including Balata, Canadian School and the Old City. They also fired stun grenades and aimed weapons at journalists and bystanders.

recentItems.title: How India’s Watchdog Became “Godi Media”
recentItems.description:
India’s “godi media” crisis goes far beyond loud anchors and partisan coverage. Concentrated corporate ownership, government advertising, political pressure and prime-time spectacle have reshaped the incentives of legacy journalism, while Islamophobic narratives repeatedly turn Muslims into convenient objects of fear. When citizens begin seeing the camera itself as an extension of power, the question is who the news ultimately serves.
